The pool was created directly on PumpSwap (the address has no 'pump' suffix) with liquidity ($30k) larger than the market cap ($21k), which points to a dev-seeded pool. The X handle it lists (TheApuPf) belongs to the real Apu token 79xB...pump.
authenticity.uncertainty: I found no X posts. The buyers could be real people who confused this coin with the trending Apu, but the buyer-to-seller ratio looks like airdrop or bot activity.
